name: Flonne
source:
Likes: Love, special effects, hero animes
Dislikes: Anyone who goes against the spirit of love.

She highly respects Seraph Lamington, but since a certain incident, she's become a Fallen Angel.
"Love will someday reach the demons!"
Even after she became a Fallen Angel, she kept lecturing about love in the Netherworld. Because of this, everyone in the Netherworld refers to her as a Love Maniac.

She loves hot-headed hero stories, and she never misses an episode of hero animes and movies with crazy special effects.

She believes that a hero shouldn't be attacked while he is transforming.

She treats everyone equally, but she is specially nice to Prinnies who are put under some pretty though and unlucky circumstances.
She's so popular among Prinnies that even a fan club (unofficial) has been formed.

[From Disgaea Infinite's "Netherworld Database".]
